name: Hünxe (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and red with a broad yellow middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hünxe (a star and an arrow on blue above the half heart-shield of Cleves on red).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Düsseldorf of 9 June 1976 the municipality of Hünxe was granted the right to bear arms, a seal, a banner and a flag; the lower half of the shield contains the half old Cleves arms.

features.role: Hünxe arms — star, arrow and half Cleves shield
